name: Tempered Brushcut
description: Draw the blade up in one cut while the second cut waits on the other track.

name: Phantom Hacksweep
description: Set the feet in the narrow balanced stance that keeps the gaze level through a cut.

name: Aegisvine
description: Cross blade and forearm in a paired guard that takes a cut on both.

name: Mowspine
description: Rap the opponent's wrist twice in quick succession until the fingers let go.

name: Scrubwrath
description: Run two lines of qi along the edge and cut through the guard on both at once.

name: Thickbelly Fortitude
description: Turn the blade to mirror the opponent's stroke and send it back along its own line.

name: Bushspine
description: Hook the opponent's blade on the second track after the first cut has pushed it wide.

name: Vinescourge
description: Rush forward on twin tracks of qi and fell the guard with a pair of heavy drops.

name: Granite Bluntspine
description: Spread the field in a pale blue cover around the paired blades and hold it against a strike.

name: Facet Brushedge
description: Drive both tracks of qi through one point so the cut pierces armor and the guard behind it.

name: Blaze Wideback
description: Draw the blade in a cut that splits into smaller branching lines at its end.

name: Siltbush
description: Shuffle over soft ground with a wide base so the feet do not sink.

name: Facetvine
description: Hold the blade across the body like a sandbar that the current of a blow must go round.

name: Decimating Machhilt
description: Slash once and let the qi branch along the edge into several narrow cuts.

name: Chime Widetip
description: Meet a stroke with the blade's tip and split its force round both sides.

name: Mow Fortitude
description: Hook the opponent's leg and drag it through soft ground until the balance is lost.

name: Vinewrath
description: Open the stroke at its end into a broad fan of cuts that covers the foes before the blade.

name: Wrathful Cutback
description: Press forward in slow wide strokes that spread across the ground and keep the foes from rising.

name: Unseen Clearcut
description: Rush through every channel of the foe's guard in one flash and appear at the far bank behind them.

name: Tempered Rivetgrip
description: Dive on the foe from a high guard and cut the instant the blade drops level.

name: Scrubdurance
description: Spread both arms like wings and cross the blade before the chest to take a blow.

name: Might Heavytang
description: Slide to one side with the blade held out like a pinion to steer the body.

name: Waning Widetip
description: Hold a still hovering gaze on the opponent and read the first twitch of the shoulders.

name: Rumble Weightedge
description: Rake the point down the opponent's forearm like a talon dragging through feathers.

name: Gustweed
description: Rise from the first cut and stoop again before the opponent's guard has closed.

name: Weeddurance
description: Lift the blade on an updraft of qi and throw the opponent's stroke high.

name: Harnessing Bluntspine
description: Hook the foe's blade or arm with the curved edge and hold the quarry still.

name: Thickbelly Ruin
description: Plunge from above with full-field qi in the blade and fell the guard beneath it.

name: Hogtying Weightedge
description: Send a cry of field qi into the foe's ear with the first stoop and daze them for the second.

name: Facet Chopedge
description: Strike a first stoop to draw the guard and the second through the same line to pierce it.

name: Gust Brushcut
description: Cut low along the floor of a hollow at a foe standing above the rim.

name: Vanishing Heavytang
description: Step down into low ground and gather the body behind the blade for a coming rush.

name: Thorn Rivetgrip
description: Raise the blade along the line of the rim to stop attacks from above.

name: Iron Chopedge
description: Plant each foot on its own step of ground and brace against a heavy cut.

name: Gust Brushedge
description: Sweep wide in an arc that follows the curve of the basin and cuts the nearest foe.

name: Hellish Hacksweep
description: Cut with qi falling through the arm like rain gathering on the edge.

name: Machhilt Spine
description: Parry along the lip of the blade and tip an incoming cut over the edge.

name: Intentweed
description: Press down with the whole weight of the blade until the opponent's weapon sinks.

name: Hoarfrost Clearcut
description: Hook the opponent's blade and draw it inward as water is drawn to the lowest ground.

name: Silt Cutback
description: Sweep in a gathering arc that draws foes toward the centre and cuts them there.

name: Might Lashdown
description: Rush down the slope behind a single heavy cut that gains speed with each stride.

name: Brutalizing Mow
description: Release all gathered field qi in one crashing cut like floodwater breaking a dam.

name: Ferocious Brushedge
description: Cut across from the left court to open the opponent's guard on that side.

name: Might Rivetgrip
description: Answer the left cut with one from the right court that closes the same gap.

name: Torrent Lashdown
description: Pivot between the two courts on the balls of both feet and change the line of attack.

name: Granite Weightedge
description: Press the blade with both hands to turn a heavy cut onto its spine.

name: Gustvine
description: Slash forward and back as a pair so that nothing stands in the cleared path.

name: Thorn Wideback
description: Interlock the blade with the opponent's across the two courts and lock it in place.

name: Rumble Hacksweep
description: Check the opponent's wind-up with a short cut that forestalls the heavy stroke.

name: Granite Machhilt
description: Bring down two felling strokes from the paired courts so the guard cannot answer both.

name: Decimating Clearcut
description: Sweep forward and back in one breath to clear a ring of foes from around the body.

name: Decimating Mow
description: Bring both edges of intent down together on the one point the foe's defenses cannot answer.

name: Brutalizing Thickbelly
description: Draw the blade along a level line at the opponent's chest as if along the horizon.

name: Chopedge Valor
description: Hold the blade and the free hand as a pair so a cut meets two guards.

name: Siltweed
description: Take one long level step toward the foe without lifting or dropping the gaze.

name: Verity Widetip
description: Hold a slow even breath and feel the opponent's rhythm through the blade.

name: Cutback Obduracy
description: Rap the blade's flat against the opponent's guard to shake its line.

name: Scrubscourge
description: Slash with two lines of field qi running parallel along the edge.

name: Unconquered Bluntspine
description: Fold the blade across the body in a parry that carries the cut off to the horizon.

name: Maiming Lashdown
description: Hook the foe's weapon from two sides with the blade and the field around it.

name: Toxinscrub
description: Cut at the exact distance the foe intends to step into and throw off the step.

name: Mayhemweed
description: Sweep two lines of field qi outward from the blade and cut every foe between them.

name: Nova Brushcut
description: Drive two parallel lines of qi into the foe at once and pierce along both.

name: Hoarfrost Heavytang
description: Hold two lines of field qi beside the body as a standing cover against the strike.

name: Glint Machhilt
description: Flash along one line of the horizon to the other and cut the foe from behind.

name: Blistering Hacksweep
description: Draw the edge bare and open in one cut that holds nothing back.

name: Granite Rivetgrip
description: Set the stance as if sworn to the ground and take a blow on the blade.

name: Gust Wideback
description: Step aside as a gust moves a leaf and let the foe's lunge pass.

name: Rampaging Wideback
description: Slash with qi that does not stop until the stroke has completed its oath.

name: Murkweed
description: Hold the edge in the foe's path and carry the cut aside along its flat.

name: Webbing Lashdown
description: Draw a line with the blade that the foe's weapon may not cross without being caught.

name: Brushedge Scourge
description: Fell the foe on open ground with a single cut that is given no place to be turned.

name: Inexorable Weightedge
description: Hold a cover of sworn qi around the blade and the body for as long as the breath lasts.

name: Brutal Cutback
description: Cut in silence on a sworn bearing and pierce through the foe's guard to the target behind.

name: Ironvine
description: Draw the blade upslope at the opponent in a cut that rises with the ground.

name: Thorn Widetip
description: Hold the guard high and set the body at an angle to the incoming force.

name: Might Thickbelly
description: Step on the rising wind and let it lift the heel clear of a low cut.

name: Weedvigil
description: Read the direction of the wind on the skin and know where the foe's stroke will bend.

name: Mowhavoc
description: Slash with a gale of qi running through the hand into the edge.

name: Ponderous Chopedge
description: Cross the foe's blade as a crosswind crosses a path and pin it where it meets.

name: Inexorable Rivetgrip
description: Wait for the wind to turn and return the opponent's cut with a counter.

name: Booming Mow
description: Sweep the blade low in a gust that cuts all those standing on the open ground.

name: Unsparing Hacksweep
description: Drive the blade forward on the wind with a series of cuts that gain on the foe.

name: Weedglimmer
description: Move with the wind in a single gust that leaves the foe cutting at an empty place.

name: Might Brushcut
description: Cut along a bearing taken on the foe's centre and hold it through the stroke.

name: Charter Chopedge
description: Hold the guard on a fixed bearing so that cuts must come to it.

name: Granite Brushedge
description: Shift the heading with one step and bring the blade to bear from a new angle.

name: Chimescrub
description: Take a bearing on the sky and judge the foe's position against it.

name: Toxinweed
description: Rap the foe's blade off its chosen heading with a short flat blow.

name: Vineruin
description: Slash along the held bearing with qi that keeps the edge true to the line.

name: Murk Machhilt
description: Face the blow like a gale-front and turn it with a broad sweep of the blade.

name: Webbing Brushcut
description: Lock the foe's weapon to a heading and hold it steady for the next cut.

name: Maiming Thickbelly
description: Cut the instant the wind shifts and break the foe's stroke at its turn.

name: Siltmow
description: Sweep along the heading with a gale at the back that scatters those in its path.

name: Brutal Heavytang
description: Run the blade's point down the held bearing and pierce whatever stands on it.

name: Devastating Widetip Scourge
description: Bring the whole bearing and gale together in one cut that no guard on that heading survives.

name: Shattering Heavytang
description: Draw the blade out long and level on the wind with the arm fully extended.

name: Merciless Clearcut
description: Cut behind the line of the first stroke to clear a foe who has slipped past.

name: Dazzling Bluntspine
description: Pace along the wind with long even steps that do not break the guard.

name: Facetbush
description: Put the free palm flat behind the blade and brace against a blow.

name: Wideback Vigil
description: Feel the path of the wind between yourself and the foe and read its disturbances.

name: Granite Cutback
description: Slash with a long exhalation of qi that lengthens the stroke along the wind.

name: Chime Mow
description: Cut across the foe's stride to check its length and drop the next step short.

name: Gyve Hacksweep
description: Hook the foe's guard with the curve of the edge and drag it into the wind.

name: Bushwrath
description: Cut a long clearing path along the wind and strike every foe standing in it.

name: Corroding Clearcut
description: Drive qi down the path of the wind and pierce a foe at its far end.

name: Unassailable Weightedge
description: Take the force of a blow into the blade and field and release it later down the wind.

name: Berserk Rivetgrip
description: Draw the blade on bare open ground with no cover and no hesitation.

name: Rumblemow
description: Return the open cut along the same arc and cut the foe a second time.

name: Mightweed
description: Slide across bare ground with light feet and let the blade lead the way.

name: Thickbelly Spine
description: Hold the blade out on the open field so any attack must meet it first.

name: Galvanizing Bluntspine
description: Look wide under the open sky and take in every foe in a single gaze.

name: Mightmow
description: Slash from open ground with qi that gives the foe no place to answer.

name: Inexorable Widetip
description: Parry in the open and let the foe's cut slide over the blade and away.

name: Ponderous Brushedge
description: Catch the foe's blade on the open edge and hold it fast.

name: Chime Lashdown
description: Strike the foe's wrist with the open hand and unbalance the cut that was coming.

name: Blaze Clearcut
description: Sweep in a full unbound circle that cuts every foe the open ground allows.

name: Glintweed
description: Run a piercing line of qi across the open field to the foe's guard.

name: Iron Bluntspine
description: Spread the field wide as the open sky and keep it as a cover about the body.

name: Hellish Weightedge
description: Let the whole open sky fall into one heavy cut with nothing left behind it.

name: Granite Wideback
description: Draw the blade with the brush hand and cut without a pause for thought.

name: Aegis Machhilt
description: Hold a guard that has been sworn to the gale and does not give way.

name: Heavytang Flash
description: Plant each footfall as an oath so that the next step follows without doubt.

name: Rumble Brushcut
description: Rap the foe's blade with a quick flick that sets it turning.

name: Merciless Chopedge
description: Chain three cuts through the brush hand on a single steady gale of qi.

name: Murk Thickbelly
description: Parry with the sworn hand and turn a heavy cut away with the flat.

name: Rivetgrip Tenacity
description: Hook the foe's weapon under an oath not to let it go until the cut is made.

name: Slag Cutback
description: Sweep with a gale of sworn qi that cuts every foe on the near side.

name: Wrathful Lashdown
description: Let the sworn gale fall with the blade in a single downward cut.

name: Ferocious Psyche Lashdown
description: Bring the full weight of a sworn gale on the one point that the foe's defenses cannot reach.
